ad_library.summary: Mega Creations trades as Mega Solar India and is running 2 live Google ads behind an identity-verified account (AR09804983159320739841, VELPULA INDIRA NIRMALA). The homepage copy is a genuine Hyderabad residential installer pitch - no-upfront-cost and pay-as-you-save financing, the Rs.78,000 PM Surya Ghar subsidy, 7% loans, 7-day installation, 25-year warranty, 100+ installations and 15+ years, with Waaree, Adani, Premier, Panasonic, Polycab and Microtek named as partners. The reason this lead is blocked rather than emailable is on the contact page: it is an unedited WordPress demo. No Meta Ad Library record was captured for this report.

funnel.meaning: There is no email address, no phone number and no working contact form anywhere on the site. The only way a paid click can become a conversation is the WhatsApp widget - so every lead depends on one channel and nothing is captured in writing.

findings: The /contact/ page is an unedited WordPress demo. It publishes info@example.com, enrollment@example.com and collab@example.com, the address 'Demo St, Brooklyn, NY 11223, United States' and the phone +1 123-456-7890, with form fields labelled 'Parent's Name' and 'Questions Parent's' and Infant / Toddler / Preschool options. A homeowner who clicks a paid ad and tries to make contact lands on a preschool enquiry form in Brooklyn.
There is no real email address or phone number anywhere on the site - only a WhatsApp chat widget. Nothing is captured in writing and nothing can be followed up if the chat goes cold.

The homepage promise is strong and unbacked: 'Leading Solar Company in Hyderabad', 100+ installations, 15+ years, certified government vendor, no-upfront-cost and pay-as-you-save - and none of it has a contact route, a project photo or a customer name behind it.
Two live creatives both point at the same landing page, so there is no second page to test a different offer or price against.
Brand partners are named (Waaree, Adani, Premier, Panasonic, Polycab, Microtek) but no product pages, datasheets or system configurations are linked from the homepage.
next_steps: Replace the demo contact page before anything else

info@example.com, a Brooklyn address, +1 123-456-7890 and a preschool form are what a paid click currently lands on. This is the single highest-value fix on the site and it is a content job, not a development one.
Publish a real phone number and email
A number and an inbox in the header and footer of every page, matching the Google Business listing, is the minimum for a business buying search traffic.
Keep the WhatsApp widget - but add a form
The widget is the only working channel. Adding a name/phone/locality form beside it gives a written record of every enquiry.
Named localities, a few project photos and one or two customer quotes would turn the strongest line on the page into something a buyer can check.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
